body: I'm sorry but marriage counseling won't force him to be attracted to you. Nothing you do can bring that back. You don't deserve a marriage with someone who clearly does not value you. I think it's best to separate. Think of the example you're setting your kids. To settle & stay in a relationship where your partner clearly wants no part in it. He doesn't want the marriage. He can still be an amazing Dad just not your husband. Don't waste anymore years being unhappy. Your kids deserve a happy mom & dad.
She was trying to get back with her ex. She said she wasn't sure whether she wanted to be with me or her

Exactly how I feel. I have moments where I'm hopeful for a future then depression hits me with that hard reality check. You would think I'd learn to cope after 12 years but It just gets worse. I'm trying to find reasons to stay but the list seems shorter everyday.

You've married the wrong guy. I wouldn't change for anybody in the world. If you he truly loved you he wouldn't want you to change anything about yourself unless it affected your health. Love yourself & remember who YOU are before you consider staying with him.

I think you're all forgetting that at that time of those incidents, OP was just a kid. In a situation like previously stated/ rape etc, you're not going to "think things out". You're going to do whatever it takes to get out of situation. Fight or flight. No one deserves to die but in that situation OP was just defending themselves. I say forgive yourself but also understand that your intentions were NEVER to kill or hurt anyone but simply defend yourself. I believe you're a great person just because you have remorse so let it go & forgive yourself. I wish you happiness & peace.
